steps.title: Retain the genuine common law and domain order
steps.text: Accepted conditional score domain constructs source Gaussian J, Markov R/S, actual disintegration/reflection, positive integrable W_y partition and original D_y before all centered z and score directions. R/S remain existential witnesses.

steps.title: Derive BOTH exact reflected curvatures
